_comment: The approval authority for Dockerfile base/tool image pins (#349). Every digest-pinned image reference in any Dockerfile must appear here with the exact same image, tag and digest, and every pin row must still be referenced by at least one Dockerfile -- the registry and the tree hold each other closed, so a base update is always a reviewable change to this file plus the Dockerfiles. A pin reference is `name:tag@sha256:<digest>`: the digest is the resolution authority (immutable), the tag is the human-readable version annotation. All digests below are the manifest-list (index) digests the named tag resolved to on `recorded`, so every architecture/platform variant of that tag is fixed by one pin and a fixed target platform always resolves to the same per-arch artifact. Checked by scripts/check-image-pins.py, which also rejects any `:latest` reference and any unexempted unpinned base. `exemptions` exist for INTERNAL images that intentionally keep a version tag; each must name an owner, an issue and a reason, exactly like quality/image-inventory.json's coverage exceptions -- an exemption nobody owns is just an exemption.
